senses.gloss: m., only in pl. אֲלִיסִים, אֲלִיסִין &c. (אלס, cmp. אלץ in Hebr. Dict. a. רסס, רצץ) ruins, debris.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:4">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (referring to <cite ref="Amos 6:11">Amos VI, 11</cite>) <he>הדין רסיסה אית מיניה אל׳</he> (read <cite ref="T00856"><he>רסיסא</he></cite>) of what is demolished by making breaches, there remain ruins, <he>והדין בקיעא לית מיניה אי</he> while of what is demolished by chopping, no ruins remain; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:18:1">Koh. R. to X, 18</cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:14:1">Cant. R. to IV, 14</cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="B00561"><he>בִּיזָא</he></cite> and <cite ref="A01928"><he>אִלְסִיס</he></cite>.
